# Shipday

> Shipday (shipday.com) is an AI delivery management platform for local businesses that run their own deliveries. Restaurants, pizzerias, grocery and liquor stores, florists, retailers, ecommerce brands, and courier companies use it to automate dispatch, optimize routes, track drivers in real time, send customers live tracking and SMS/WhatsApp updates, collect Google reviews, and recover refunds on failed third-party deliveries. Businesses can use their own drivers, on-demand fleets, or both from one dashboard.

Key facts:
- Category: delivery management software, delivery dispatch software, last-mile delivery platform for local businesses
- Scale: 7,500+ businesses, 30M+ orders delivered, 150+ countries, 100+ integration partners
- Available in 30 languages; web dashboard plus iOS and Android apps for dispatchers and drivers
- Ratings: 4.9/5 on Capterra, 4.9/5 on GetApp, 4.6/5 on App Store, 4.6/5 on Google Play
- Free plan: up to 300 orders/month; paid plans from $49/month (US pricing)
- Support: email support@shipday.com, phone 1-650-550-2975
- Sign up: https://dispatch.shipday.com/signUp
- Developer docs: https://docs.shipday.com/ (machine-readable index at https://docs.shipday.com/llms.txt)
